headline: Japan Utilities Face Higher Spot LNG Demand Amid Electricity Price Surge
summary: Japanese power utilities may increase spot LNG purchases as rising domestic electricity prices restore power generation profitability. Japan's physical spark spread turned positive on a seven-day average.
why: Japan is one of the world's largest importers of liquefied natural gas (LNG), making domestic utility demand a key driver of spot gas pricing in Asia.

impacts.name: LNG Spot Asia
impacts.why: Positive power generation margins encourage Japanese utilities to buy more spot LNG cargoes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
